utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Come by around 10 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 10 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a few tools and I’m happy to pitch in with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I’ll try not to miss the parts that changed this time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Noah. I’ll keep an eye on what changed and help you sort the rest out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up steam again, so folks are asking around for volunteers and a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know where and when folks are meeting so I can plan for that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, they’re looking at the community hall on Saturday morning, around 9. I’ll ask around and see if I can get you the exact setup details too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Just point me to what needs fixing, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the back fence latch by the alley, and the porch step still wobbles.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll head over and fix both—the latch first, then I’ll steady that porch step.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’m spreading the word now. You should come by the repair drive too if you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll try to make it by, if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll save you a spot. I’ll keep spreading the word and hope you can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I can help you slot in a time or sort the volunteer needs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. What times are open for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I head over, can you confirm what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the hinge on the back gate and the loose board by the drive. I can point them out when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll come by and take a look at the hinge and the loose board when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup if you need me to. Just tell me what time the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: After school pickup works. The repair drive starts at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I can do that after pickup and be there by 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard folks were still sorting out the repair drive. Has anything changed since this morning?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not much has changed since this morning, just a few more people said they can help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like the repair drive is picking up a bit, then. Good to hear more hands are coming in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive for the neighborhood fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, if you want me to take a look at what's still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I think there’s still a bit left to sort out. I’d appreciate you taking a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks. I’ll come take a look and see what still needs sorting out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll keep folks posted and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep everyone posted and check back if anything changes on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting moving, so I’m keeping an ear out for what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I can help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep track of what turns up. If I hear specifics on the busted parts, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, let’s keep it simple: I’m planning to check what still needs fixing and then get people paired up to handle it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good to me. Point me at the first thing that still needs fixing, and I’ll help sort the pairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I heard about that, but I may have missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I heard it’s still on for Saturday. I’ll check the latest and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll wait for your update on whether it’s still happening Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools in the shed if you need one for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll keep that in mind if I need something for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Eli. Just let me know if you need a hand with anything for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive, Quinn. Tell me what still needs attention and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara. The big stuff is the loose porch step and the stuck gate latch, and if you know anyone with tools, spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll spread the word and keep an eye out for anyone with tools. I can also come by to help with the porch step or latch if you still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate a few folks if you want me to spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot. I can send you the addresses and a short list of what each place needs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, send them over and I’ll start reaching out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ve got the repair drive list ready and I’ll keep it moving. What’s your priority for today?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d start with the biggest repair gap and any missing fasteners or connectors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m on it, and I’ll start with the biggest gap plus the missing connectors and fasteners.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help sort it out if you point me to what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I could use your help sorting the donations and loading the boxes after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, I can do that after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the broken shelves and loose hinges from the repair drive list. I can take a look if you want.
